concurrent_verified.prompt: Explain why the sky appears blue in two sentences.

message.content: Sunlight enters the atmosphere and scatters in all directions, with shorter blue wavelengths scattering much more strongly than other colors due to Rayleigh scattering. This widespread scattering of blue light across the sky is what causes it to appear blue to our eyes.
